mode: Every documented route that installs an OMP client config was re-run from its own quickstart blocks at the candidate, and each run reads the setting back from the client it installed. The inference-host route carries from v0.6.5: it installs no client config and its blocks are unchanged. No component changed.

rtx4090-native.installed_client_setting: startup.checkUpdate = false, read back from the client the route installed
rtx4090-native.note: rerun path with the 18 GB artifact present; operate, provider and acceptance passed

rtx5090-container-host.carried_from: v0.6.5; the inference-host route installs no client config and its blocks are unchanged

rtx5090-windows-client.installed_client_setting: startup.checkUpdate = false, read back from the client the route installed
rtx5090-windows-client.note: clone substituted with the candidate commit and verified installable, as every pre-cut run is

rtx5090-macos-client.installed_client_setting: startup.checkUpdate = false, read back from the client the route installed
rtx5090-macos-client.note: run from an isolated HOME; vision, resume, a server restart with the session continued, and fail-closed all passed

channel_contract.note: the config every client route installs disables the pinned client's startup update check; `omp config get startup.checkUpdate` returned false on all three hosts after their routes ran

documented_blocks_verbatim.note: every executed step's bytes hashed to the documented block's SHA-256 in the bundle manifest; the only substitutions are the reader's own SSH destination and, on the two Windows routes, the pre-cut clone of the candidate commit

fail_closed_intact.note: each route's fail-closed check still fails the outage request: macOS with the tunnel stopped, the Windows client after stop-ninfer.sh, the RTX 4090 after Control-Release -Action Stop

tunnel_ownership.note: the runner now refuses a forward it does not own and releases its forward on the error path; both are regression tests that fail on the previous runner

hosts_restored.note: RTX 5090 appliance: production serving on 18088, restart policy `unless-stopped`, supervisor hold released, the route container removed. RTX 4090 host: the lane the route installed serves (v0.6.1-beta.1, running, ready, lease held) and the owner's OMP agent directory is restored. Windows client host: owner's OMP agent directory restored. Mac: nothing to restore - the route ran in an isolated HOME.

corrections_carried: This release's evidence also carries the correction to v0.6.5's restored-incumbent claim; see corrections_to_earlier_records in the qualification receipt.
